svg.title: Separate historical inputs and future development targets
svg.desc: Accepted price history enters independent backward-looking SQL features and forward targets restricted to pre-2026 observations. Twelve features and development targets are numerically reconciled, joined with chronological membership, and stored in a separate versioned modeling dataset. Final 2026 numeric targets and scores remain uncomputed. Chronological model development is implemented separately; final testing remains reserved.
svg.text: Keep the forecast inputs separate from the future outcome.
Implemented SQL and numerical checks · Trained-model development evaluated separately
Past returns, variance, downside, and drawdown
Squared returns from t+1 through t+20
Source clipped before 2026 before forward windows
Reconcile values and session endpoints; apply EV-001
Independent NumPy calculations and future-price perturbation checks
Feature, target, membership, and joined development tables; four Parquet exports
2026 feature/date rows are retained; all numeric final-test outcomes and model scores remain uncomputed.
Historical benchmarks and three trained candidates evaluated on 2023–2025 only.
Revised price histories remain a limitation; causal transformations do not prove point-in-time source availability.
